attendance.label: Attendance
attendance.text: Share of the session's roll-call votes on which the member recorded a position. cast (Yea/Nay/Present) divided by eligible roll calls of their chamber, as a percentage. Source: data/state/ms/votes.

cosponsored.label: Bills cosponsored
cosponsored.text: Count of bills on which the member is an additional (non-first-listed) author this session. Source: data/state/ms/legislation.

enacted_rate.label: Enacted rate
enacted_rate.text: Of the bills the member principally authored, the share approved by the Governor this session (official history action "Approved by Governor"). Source: data/state/ms/legislation.

party_unity.label: Party unity
party_unity.text: Share of substantive votes (final passage and veto overrides; procedural motions excluded) on which the member voted with the majority of their own party. Rolls where the member did not cast Yea/Nay, or where their party split evenly, are excluded. Source: data/state/ms/votes (positions + aggregate party_totals).

sponsored.label: Bills sponsored
sponsored.text: Count of bills on which the member is the principal (first-listed) author this session. LegiScan does not distinguish primary from co-authors for Mississippi, so the first-listed author is taken as the principal. Source: data/state/ms/legislation.
